title: JapanesePod101 — 温泉の文化 (Japanese Onsen Culture)
description: From JapanesePod101's Japanese culture series. Introduces the tradition of onsen (hot spring bathing) in Japan: the difference between 温泉 and 銭湯, onsen etiquette (タオルの扱い, 入る前に体を洗う), types of baths (露天風呂, 内風呂), and the concept of 湯治 (healing through hot springs).
creator: JapanesePod101 (Innovative Language Learning)
